fusions.name: Plague Hop
fusions.desc: Leaps to a target up to 7 tiles away and bites it with venom for 13 damage, leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance of [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Nip and Spring
fusions.desc: Flicks a barbed nip that deals 4 damage and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Ceiling Cling
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles and you cling where you land: your dodge chance rises 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hard to Squash
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher at all times.
